headline: Mechanical Maintenance Technician
summary: Mechanical maintenance technician with four years in a sugar mill and a coconut processing plant in Negros Oriental. I plan and carry out preventive maintenance, measure wear and alignment precisely, and inspect repaired equipment for quality before it goes back into production. I work closely with production operators.

experience.title: Mechanical Maintenance Technician
experience.paragraph: Part of a six-person maintenance crew for a plant producing coconut oil and desiccated coconut.
bullets: Carry out preventive maintenance on expellers, dryers, pumps and conveyors.
Measure shafts, bearings and alignment with micrometers, dial gauges and laser tools.
Check repaired machines against quality standards before handing them back to production.
Run daily checks of plant equipment with operators and follow lockout safety rules.

experience.title: Maintenance Mechanic
experience.paragraph: Worked the milling season on mill tandem and boiler-house equipment.
bullets: Repaired and overhauled mill rollers, gearboxes and pumps.
Monitored machine performance during production and reported problems early.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering Technology
